content: Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bɑ derɑ Akɑsiɑ, Yorɑmun bii dɑ̃ɑko u bɑndu di win tundon ɑyerɔ. Domi yibɛrɛ be bɑ nɑ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ bɑ win mɑɑbu kpuro wɔri bɑ ɡo. Nɡe mɛyɑ Akɑsiɑ u kɑ bɑndu wɑ u di.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ yiru. Wɔ̃ɔ tiɑ u kuɑ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Atɑli, Omirin bii.
U sĩɑwɑ Akɑbun yɛnuɡibun yirɑ sɔɔ. Domi bwisi kɔ̃siyɑ win mɛro u nùn kɛ̃mɔ u kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ nɡe mɛ Akɑbun yɛnuɡibu bɑ kuɑ. Ben miyɑ u bwisi kɛ̃ɔbu wɑ win tundon ɡɔɔn biru. Bɑ nùn bwisi kɔ̃si kɑ̃, mɑ yi nùn kɑm koosiɑ.
Domi u kɑ Yorɑmu Akɑbun bii, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko tɑbu dɑ bu kɑ Hɑsɑɛli, Sirin sinɑ boko tɑbu wɔri Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Mɑ Siriɡibu bɑ Yorɑmu mɛɛrɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ u ɡɔsirɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ bu kɑ win mɛɛrɑ ye tim kuɑ. Yerɑ Akɑsiɑ, Yorɑmun bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u nɑ Yisirɛɛli mi u kɑ nùn wɑ mi bɑ nùn tim nɛndu kuɑmmɛ. Domi mɛɛrɑ ye, yɑ ǹ sɑnɔ mɔ̀.

Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Akɑsiɑ u Yorɑmu berɑm dɑ kpɑ u kɑ kɑm ko mi. Ye Akɑsiɑ u turɑ mi, yerɑ wi kɑ Yorɑmu bɑ Yehu, Nimusin bii wɔrim dɑ. N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u Yehu wi ɡɔsɑ u kɑ Akɑbun yɛnuɡibu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u Akɑbun yɛnuɡii be kpeerɑsiɑmɔ, yerɑ u kɑ Akɑsiɑn sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu yinnɑ kɑ win mɑɑbun bibu be bɑ nùn kɔ̃su. Mɑ Yehu u be kpuro mwɛɛrɑ u ɡo.

Mɑ bɑ Akɑsiɑn tii kɑsu bɑ mwɑ Sɑmɑriɔ, mi u kukuɑ. Bɑ kɑ nùn nɑ Yehun mi, bɑ ɡo. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ boko Yosɑfɑti wi u Gusunɔ kɑsu kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kpuron bii. Akɑsiɑn bwese te sɔɔ, ɡoo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ dee dee u kɑ bɑndu di.
Ye Atɑli u wɑ win bii Akɑsiɑ u ɡu, yerɑ u Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bibu kpuro ɡo.

Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ bii be ɡoomɔ, yerɑ Yosebɑ, sinɑ boko Yorɑmun bii tɔn kurɔ u Yoɑsi, Akɑsiɑn bii suɑ u beruɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ. Mɑ u nùn suɑ u kɑ dɑ kɑ win nɔɔrio mi kpin yenu wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Nɡe mɛyɑ Yosebɑ, yɑ̃ku kowo Yehoyɑdɑn kurɔ u kɑ Yoɑsi wɔrɑ Atɑlin nɔmɑn di, u ǹ kɑ nùn wɑ u ɡo. Yosebɑ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Akɑsiɑn sesu.
Bɑ nùn beruɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Domi Atɑli u bɑndu dii sɑɑ ye.
